verdict.summary: The New Feature, utilizing AI for content moderation in the European Union and the United States, poses moderate compliance risks due to the collection and storage of user-generated content data for 30 days. Key concerns include data protection, privacy, and potential GDPR and CCPA implications.

issues.title: Data Retention Policy
issues.description: The feature stores data for 30 days, which may not be fully compliant with GDPR and CCPA guidelines that require data to be kept for no longer than necessary.
issues.remediation: Implement a data retention policy that ensures data is kept for the minimum necessary period, with clear guidelines for data deletion and anonymization.

issues.title: Cross-Border Data Transfers
issues.description: The feature's operation in both the EU and the US raises concerns about cross-border data transfers, which must comply with GDPR and CCPA regulations.
issues.impact: Potential fines, legal action, and reputational damage
issues.remediation: Ensure that cross-border data transfers are carried out in accordance with GDPR and CCPA requirements, using appropriate mechanisms such as Standard Contractual Clauses or Binding Corporate Rules.

evidence_cited.content: Personal data shall be kept in a form which permits identification of data subjects for no longer than is necessary for the purposes for which the personal data are processed.
A business shall not collect or sell a consumer's personal information if the business does not provide a notice of the right to opt-out of the sale of the consumer's personal information.
